name: exercise ball seated hamstring stretch
description: Seated on a stability ball with one leg extended, you lean forward to stretch the back of the thigh.
instructions: Sit tall on a stability ball with your feet flat on the floor.
Slide one foot forward and straighten that leg, heel on the floor and toes up.
Rest your hands on your bent knee and lean forward from the hips with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a stretch behind the straight thigh and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Sit back up and switch legs.
